## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle Tang-period Chinese translation of Asaṅga's *Vajracchedikā*-summary verses (the *kārikā*-text of [T1514](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0035)) together with Vasubandhu's prose-commentary on those verses. Translated by Yìjìng 義淨. Signature: 「無著菩薩造頌／世親菩薩釋／三藏法師義淨奉制譯」. The Taishō header cross-references [T1511](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0032) ([菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) Bodhiruci's earlier Vasubandhu translation) and the related works at [T1512](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0033) / [T1514](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0035).

**Abstract**

T1513 is Yìjìng's Tang re-translation of the integrated Asaṅga-Vasubandhu *Vajracchedikā*-commentary (the same Indic text-cluster that [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) Bodhiruci had translated as [T1511](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0032) some two centuries earlier). Yìjìng's translation reflects the more developed Tang philological apparatus and the *néngduàn* (能斷) Sanskrit-preserving translation idiom. Translation falls within Yìjìng's documented post-pilgrimage Tang activity (700–713).
